title: Numbers 19:4-5 — Eleazar sprinkles blood; the heifer is burned
summary: Numbers 19:4-5 in English: Eleazar the priest takes some of the red heifer's blood, sprinkles it seven times toward the tent of meeting, and the heifer is burned in his sight. The words blood and heifer are in colour, and the first letters 'El' of Eleazar are coloured differently from the rest of the name.

text.text: 4 ‘Next Eleazar the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and sprinkle some of its blood toward the front of the tent of meeting seven times.
5 ‘Then the heifer shall be burned in his sight; its hide and its flesh and its blood, with its refuse, shall be burned.

numbers.note: the blood is sprinkled toward the tent of meeting seven times

uncertain: In 'Eleazar' the first two letters 'El' are coloured (E blue, l brown) differently from the rest; the slide does not explain why.
